subject: DI03005011

title.en: Level and classification of level instruments
title.gu: Level તથા Level Instruments નું વર્ગીકરણ

h.en: Level and classification of level instruments
h.gu: Level તથા Level Instruments નું વર્ગીકરણ

body.en:
Definition / principle

Level is the height or interface position of material relative to a stated vessel datum. Direct devices observe/contact the surface or a floating element; indirect devices infer level from another measurable property.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Syllabus classification: first direct—probe/tape, sight glass, float; then indirect—air-trap box, diaphragm box, bellows system. Continuous indication differs from a point-level alarm. For hydrostatic methods, p−pgas=ρghonly under the stated density/datum and static conditions. A closed vessel’s gas pressure must be compensated; do not treat it as an open tank.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Stated vessel datum સામે material ની height/interface position Level છે. Direct devices surface અથવા floating element ને observe/contact કરે છે. Indirect devices બીજી measurable property પરથી level નક્કી કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Syllabus મુજબ પ્રથમ Direct—probe/tape, sight glass, float; પછી Indirect—air-trap box, diaphragm box, bellows system. Continuous indication તથા point-level alarm જુદાં છે. Hydrostatic method માં stated density/datum તથા static condition પર p−pgas=ρgh છે. Closed vessel નું gas pressure compensate કરો; તેને open tank ન માનો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

Direct manual level measurement with a graduated probe or a tape and sounding weight.

Principle

The wetted length or measured distance to the surface relates directly to level from a known datum.

Construction

A rigid graduated dipstick/probe reaches the required tank datum; alternatively a flexible graduated tape carries a suitable plumb bob and reel. A fixed reference point and known tank geometry establish the reading basis. A suitable surface-indicating paste may be used only when approved. This syllabus method is manual sounding, not a substitute name for an electrical conductivity probe.

Working

For innage, lower the clean probe or tape to the specified bottom datum, withdraw it and read the wetted length. For ullage, measure the reference-to-surface gap and subtract from the known reference-to-bottom distance. Keep the tape vertical and the datum consistent. Avoid sloshing effects and identify whether the reading is total liquid level or a separate interface. Volume conversion requires the tank calibration chart, not height alone.

Applications

Simple checks in safely accessible compatible tanks and verification of another level indicator.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Intermittent and operator-dependent; opening a pressurized, toxic, flammable or oxygen-deficient vessel is not a permitted routine action. Use authorized access/static-control/confined-space procedures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Graduated probe અથવા tape/sounding weight વડે direct manual level measurement છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Wetted length અથવા surface સુધી measured distance પરથી known datum સામે level મળે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Rigid graduated dipstick/probe required tank datum સુધી પહોંચે છે. બીજા form માં graduated tape, plumb bob તથા reel હોય છે. Fixed reference તથા tank geometry reading basis નક્કી કરે છે. Approved હોય તો suitable indicating paste લઈ શકાય. આ manual sounding method છે, electrical conductivity probe નું બીજું નામ નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Innage માટે clean probe/tape specified bottom datum સુધી લઈ જઈ withdraw કરીને wetted length વાંચો. Ullage માટે reference-to-surface gap માપી known reference-to-bottom distance માંથી ઘટાડો. Tape vertical તથા datum consistent રાખો. Sloshing ટાળો. Level total liquid નું છે કે interface નું તે ઓળખો. Volume માટે tank calibration chart જોઈએ, ફક્ત height નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Safely accessible compatible tanks માં simple checks તથા અન્ય indicator નું verification.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Intermittent તથા operator-dependent છે. Pressurized, toxic, flammable અથવા oxygen-deficient vessel ખોલવું routine permitted action નથી. Authorized access/static-control/confined-space procedure અનુસરો.

body.en:
Definition

A direct indicator showing liquid level in a transparent communicating tube or viewing chamber.

Principle

Hydrostatic equilibrium makes the sight-tube level follow vessel level when liquid density and gas-space pressures correspond.

Construction

A rated transparent tube or flat-glass chamber is connected to the vessel at a lower liquid tapping and an upper gas-space tapping for a closed vessel. Isolation valves, drain/vent provisions and protective guards are provided as required. The scale is referenced to the vessel datum. The upper connection equalizes gas pressure; it is not optional in an ordinary closed-vessel communicating arrangement.

Working

With the correct connections open and clear, the same gas pressure acts above the vessel and sight-tube liquids. Liquid enters or leaves the tube until the levels correspond. Read the meniscus against the scale. If a connection is blocked, the displayed level can remain trapped and be wrong despite a clear-looking glass. Density/temperature differences between vessel and external tube can also introduce error.

Applications

Local visual level in compatible, properly rated process vessels.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Glass breakage, pressure/temperature and corrosion hazards require correct ratings and protection. Never use unqualified glass or crack open valves without the isolation SOP.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transparent communicating tube/viewing chamber માં liquid level બતાવતું direct indicator છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Liquid density તથા gas pressures યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે hydrostatic equilibrium થી sight-tube level vessel level ને અનુસરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Rated transparent tube/flat-glass chamber vessel ના lower liquid tap તથા closed vessel માટે upper gas-space tap સાથે જોડાય છે. Required isolation valves, drain/vent તથા guards હોય છે. Scale vessel datum સામે છે. Upper connection gas pressure equalize કરે છે; ordinary closed-vessel communicating arrangement માં તેને મનસ્વી રીતે છોડાય નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Connections યોગ્ય રીતે open/clear હોય ત્યારે vessel તથા sight-tube ઉપર same gas pressure હોય છે. Liquid flow થઈ levels correspond કરે ત્યાં equilibrium બને છે. Scale સામે meniscus વાંચો. Connection blocked હોય તો glass clear દેખાય છતાં trapped reading ખોટી હોય શકે છે. Vessel/external tube ની density/temperature difference પણ error આપે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Compatible તથા properly rated process vessels માં local visual level.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Glass breakage, pressure/temperature તથા corrosion hazards માટે correct ratings/protection જોઈએ. Unqualified glass અથવા SOP વગર valve opening ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A direct device following the liquid surface with a buoyant float.

Principle

Buoyancy supports the float; surface movement produces corresponding float displacement.

Construction

A hollow or low-density compatible float rests at the surface and is guided to avoid lateral motion. In the illustrated mechanical form, a cable passes over a pulley to a counterweight and graduated indicator. Other designs use a stem, lever or electrical pickup. The float must remain buoyant at the lowest expected liquid density and free from fouling.

Working

When the liquid rises, the float rises and moves the cable/lever. The transmission converts travel into a level indication calibrated for the linkage direction. When the surface falls, the counterweight or linkage keeps the system following it. A density change alters immersion depth and can shift indicated level; foaming, fouling or a leaking float can prevent correct following.

Applications

Tank level indication and suitable float-actuated level switches.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Moving parts require space and maintenance; agitation, foam, coating and density variation limit service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Buoyant float વડે liquid surface ને અનુસરતું direct device છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Buoyancy float ને support કરે છે. Surface movement પ્રમાણે float ખસે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Compatible hollow/low-density float surface પર રહે છે અને guide lateral motion રોકે છે. Drawing ના mechanical form માં cable pulley પરથી counterweight તથા graduated indicator સાથે જોડાય છે. Other designs stem, lever અથવા electrical pickup વાપરે છે. Lowest expected liquid density પર પણ buoyancy તથા free movement જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Liquid ઊંચું થાય ત્યારે float તથા cable/lever ખસે છે. Transmission linkage direction મુજબ level indication આપે છે. Level ઘટતાં counterweight/linkage float ને follow કરાવે છે. Density બદલાય તો immersion depth તથા reading બદલાય છે. Foam, fouling અથવા leaking float થી following બગડે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Tank level indication તથા suitable float-actuated level switches.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Moving parts ને space/maintenance જોઈએ. Agitation, foam, coating તથા density variation limitations છે.

body.en:
Definition

An indirect hydrostatic method transmitting pressure through air trapped in an immersed inverted box.

Principle

Liquid pressure compresses the trapped gas; its pressure reflects the depth of the internal gas-liquid interface.

Construction

An inverted open-bottom box or bell is fixed at a known position in the tank. A sealed air line connects its trapped upper gas pocket to a pressure indicator. The lower opening admits liquid as the trapped gas compresses. No continuous external purge-air supply is shown; that would be a bubbler/purge method, not this closed air-trap arrangement.

Working

As tank level increases, pressure at the internal interface increases and compresses the air. The air-line indicator senses this pressure and is calibrated to level for the stated geometry, liquid density and initial gas condition. Interface position shifts with compression, so blindly using pressure divided byρgwith a fixed bottom datum can be inaccurate. Air leaks, dissolution and temperature changes cause drift. The diagram explicitly marks the internal interface rather than pretending it is fixed at the box mouth.

Applications

Simple indirect level indication where air trapping and service conditions can be maintained.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Requires gas-tight connections and calibration for interface movement. Not automatically suitable for closed pressurized tanks without gas-space pressure compensation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Immersed inverted box માં trapped air દ્વારા hydrostatic pressure transmit કરતી indirect level method છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Liquid pressure trapped gas compress કરે છે. Gas pressure internal gas-liquid interface ની depth દર્શાવે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Inverted open-bottom box/bell tank માં known position પર fixed હોય છે. Sealed air line upper trapped-gas pocket ને pressure indicator સાથે જોડે છે. Gas compress થાય ત્યારે lower opening થી liquid અંદર આવે છે. Continuous external purge-air supply નથી; તે bubbler/purge method છે, આ closed air-trap નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Tank level વધતાં internal interface પર pressure વધે છે અને air compress થાય છે. Air-line indicator stated geometry, density તથા initial gas condition માટે level તરીકે calibrate થાય છે. Compression થી interface position બદલાય છે, તેથી fixed box-bottom datum સામે એકલું p/(ρg) ખોટું પડી શકે છે. Air leaks, dissolution તથા temperature થી drift થાય છે. Drawing internal interface અલગ બતાવે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Air trapping તથા service conditions જાળવી શકાય ત્યાં simple indirect indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Gas-tight connections તથા interface movement માટે calibration જોઈએ. Gas-space compensation વગર closed pressurized tank માટે આપમેળે યોગ્ય નથી.

body.en:
Definition

An indirect level method sensing hydrostatic pressure through a flexible diaphragm box at a known depth.

Principle

Level-dependent external pressure deflects a diaphragm and is transmitted to a pressure/level receiver.

Construction

A rigid box mounted near the vessel’s lower region carries a flexible, compatible diaphragm exposed to the liquid. A sealed fill/transmission connection couples the diaphragm to a receiver; the illustrated form uses a liquid-filled capillary and pressure indicator. The fill prevents direct process contact with the receiver. A mounting datum and a specified reference pressure complete the installation.

Working

Liquid head increases diaphragm loading, which transmits pressure through the sealed fill to the receiver. The receiver is calibrated in level after allowing for fill-column head, liquid density and zero/elevation effects. In an open tank the gas reference is atmosphere; in a closed tank the gas pressure must be compensated separately. Fill thermal expansion, gas bubbles or a damaged diaphragm can change the indication independently of level.

Applications

Compatible dirty/corrosive-service isolation when the diaphragm/fill system is correctly selected.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Diaphragm compatibility, fill temperature limits and capillary mounting matter; do not break the sealed system casually.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Known depth પર flexible diaphragm box વડે hydrostatic pressure sense કરતી indirect level method છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Level પ્રમાણે external pressure diaphragm deflect કરે છે અને pressure/level receiver સુધી transmit થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Vessel ના lower region માં rigid box પર flexible compatible diaphragm liquid સામે હોય છે. Sealed transmission connection receiver સુધી જાય છે. Drawing માં liquid-filled capillary તથા pressure indicator છે. Fill receiver ને direct process contact થી અલગ રાખે છે. Mounting datum તથા specified reference pressure જરૂરી છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Liquid head diaphragm loading વધારે છે. Sealed fill pressure receiver સુધી પહોંચાડે છે. Fill-column head, density તથા zero/elevation effects સાથે level calibration થાય છે. Open tank માં atmosphere reference છે. Closed tank માં gas pressure અલગ compensate કરવું પડે છે. Fill thermal expansion, bubbles અથવા damaged diaphragm થી level બદલાયા વગર reading બદલાય છે.

ઉપયોગો

યોગ્ય diaphragm/fill પસંદ હોય ત્યારે dirty/corrosive service isolation.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Diaphragm compatibility, fill temperature limits તથા capillary mounting મહત્વના છે. Sealed system મનસ્વી રીતે ન ખોલો.

body.en:
Definition

An indirect level indicator converting liquid-head pressure into bellows displacement.

Principle

Hydrostatic pressure force extends/compresses a bellows against elastic/spring restoring force.

Construction

A lower vessel pressure tap and a suitable impulse connection feed a bellows receiver. A spring and mechanical linkage move a pointer on a level-calibrated scale. The receiver reference is atmosphere for the illustrated vented tank. A defined tap/receiver elevation and compatible impulse-line liquid are needed to establish the zero; closed tanks need an additional gas-space reference arrangement.

Working

Rising liquid level increases head at the tap and therefore bellows force. The moving bellows end operates the linkage until restoring force balances the pressure force. The scale converts calibrated displacement into height. If liquid density changes, the same level creates a different pressure; blocked or gas-filled liquid impulse lines can also cause erroneous indication. The method senses head, not the surface directly.

Applications

Hydrostatic level indication in suitable vented vessels.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Density, elevation, temperature and bellows overload must be controlled; do not confuse this with a buoyancy displacer unless that different design is specified.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Liquid-head pressure ને bellows displacement માં ફેરવતું indirect level indicator છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Hydrostatic pressure force bellows ને elastic/spring restoring force સામે ખસેડે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Lower vessel pressure tap તથા impulse connection bellows receiver સુધી જાય છે. Spring/linkage pointer ને level-calibrated scale પર ચલાવે છે. Drawing vented tank માટે atmospheric reference બતાવે છે. Tap/receiver elevation તથા impulse-line fluid થી zero નક્કી થાય છે. Closed tank માટે gas-space reference arrangement જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Level વધતાં tap પર head તથા bellows force વધે છે. Restoring force balance કરે ત્યાં સુધી bellows/linkage ખસે છે. Calibrated displacement height માં દેખાય છે. Density બદલાય તો same level પર pressure બદલાય છે. Blocked/gas-filled liquid impulse line પણ error આપે છે. Method head sense કરે છે, surface direct નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable vented vessels માં hydrostatic level indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Density, elevation, temperature તથા overload ધ્યાનમાં લો. આને અલગ buoyancy-displacer design સાથે ભેળવશો નહીં.

body.en:
Given—illustrative data

Vented tankρ=800 kg/m³, level1.50mabove pressure datum. No impulse-line head offset.

Find

Gauge pressure due to liquid head.

Formula

Substitution and calculation

Answer with units

Validity check

Valid for the declared density/vented reference; closed-vessel gas pressure is not included.
body.gu:
આપેલ—Illustrative Data

Vented tank માટેρ=800 kg/m³, pressure datum ઉપર level1.50m છે. Impulse-line head offset નથી.

શોધો

Liquid head થી gauge pressure શોધો.

સૂત્ર

કિંમતો મૂકી ગણતરી

એકમ સાથે જવાબ

Validity Check

Declared density/vented reference માટે valid છે. Closed-vessel gas pressure સામેલ નથી.

body.en:
Task and evidence

Compare all six methods with a labelled datum. Explain why a closed tank requires gas-pressure compensation and why air-trap interface movement differs from a bubbler. Never open or enter a vessel to obtain demonstration evidence.
body.gu:
Task તથા Evidence

છ methods ને labelled datum સાથે સરખાવો. Closed tank માં gas-pressure compensation તથા air-trap interface movement કેમ જરૂરી છે તે સમજાવો. Air trap ને bubbler ન માનો. Evidence માટે vessel ખોલશો/અંદર જશો નહીં.
